verdicts.reason: Both have the same main faults: '$3' now sits above '2 FOR', so the offer reads backwards. The FIZZBANG! logo is shrunk into a stray pill at the bottom that lines up with nothing. The Find a Store CTA floats alone in the top-right corner, away from its copy. A also leaves a ~160px dead gap between the can (pushed far left) and the text column, while B pulls the can closer for a slightly more cohesive group, though it has a wide empty left margin and a loose gap under '2 FOR'.
